GOFO Completes Acquisition of CIRRO E-Commerce, Combining U.S. Market Expertise with Nationwide Delivery Infrastructure

# GOFO Completes Acquisition of CIRRO E-Commerce, Combining U.S. Market Expertise with Nationwide Delivery Infrastructure

 

Feb 09, 2026, 11:00 ET

- The acquisition adds CIRRO E-Commerce' s U.S. market expertise, established customer base, and e-commerce integrations, strengthening GOFO' s commercial execution and customer experience capabilities.
- GOFO has appointed Ron Jansen as Chief Commercial Officer, U.S., and Vincent D' Amato as Chief Sales Officer, U.S., to lead commercial strategy and U.S. sales execution as integration progresses.
- The acquisition builds on GOFO and CIRRO E-Commerce' s strategic partnership announced in October 2025 and is being unveiled at Manifest 2026, underscoring GOFO' s continued investment in the U.S. market.

LAS VEGAS, Feb. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- GOFO, a technology-driven last-mile logistics provider in the U.S., today announced that it has completed the acquisition of CIRRO E-Commerce, a global e-commerce logistics solutions provider. The acquisition, unveiled at Manifest 2026, supports GOFO's continued commercial growth in the U.S. market and expands its ability to serve merchants with a more seamless end-to-end delivery experience.

 

 Left to right: Ron Jansen, Chief Commercial Officer, U.S., GOFO, and Vincent D’Amato, Chief Sales Officer, U.S., GOFO. 

Strategic Rationale and Integration The acquisition combines CIRRO E-Commerce' s U.S. market expertise, customer relationships, and established e-commerce integrations with GOFO' s nationwide delivery network and operational infrastructure. Together, the combined organization will strengthen commercial execution, improve the customer experience, and support reliable delivery outcomes for U.S. merchants and e-commerce customers.

" Completing this acquisition is a highly strategic step for GOFO in the U.S. market," said Leon Li, CEO, GOFO (U.S.). " CIRRO E-Commerce brings strong local market expertise, high-performing commercial and customer experience teams, and established e-commerce integrations. GOFO brings network scale, automation, and operational discipline. Together, we will deliver a stronger, more seamless experience for U.S. shippers."

Leadership Integration and Executive Appointments As part of the integration, members of CIRRO E-Commerce' s leadership team will join GOFO to support U.S. market expansion. GOFO also announced two executive appointments to lead commercial strategy and U.S. sales execution.

* Ron Jansen has been appointed Chief Commercial Officer, U.S., GOFO, and will lead commercial strategy and growth across the U.S. market. * Vincent D' Amato has been appointed Chief Sales Officer, U.S., GOFO, and will oversee U.S. sales execution and customer expansion.

" CIRRO E-Commerce' s commercial, customer experience (CX), and product and technology capabilities are highly complementary to GOFO' s network strength," said Ron Jansen, Chief Commercial Officer, U.S., GOFO. " With one integrated organization, we can move faster commercially and deliver more reliable outcomes for customers across the U.S." " Our focus is continuity and customer growth," said Vincent D' Amato, Chief Sales Officer, U.S., GOFO. " By pairing CIRRO E-Commerce' s market expertise and customer-facing teams with GOFO' s nationwide last-mile infrastructure, we can help merchants drive revenue growth, deliver more consistent service, and scale delivery performance."

Employee Integration and Business Continuity CIRRO E-Commerce employees will be integrated into GOFO, and customer service and day-to-day operations will continue as usual throughout the transition.

Outlook and Industry Engagement GOFO will continue investing in the U.S. market and expanding its domestic network capabilities. The company is unveiling the acquisition at Manifest 2026 as part of its commitment to engaging with the logistics industry and plans to participate in additional industry events and forums.

About GOFO GOFO is a technology-driven last-mile logistics network serving merchants and consumers across the United States. Founded in 2023 and guided by the brand philosophy "Drive Efficiency, Deliver Trust," GOFO combines advanced technology with localized operations to deliver precise, reliable, and scalable delivery solutions. Operating across 40 states through 120+ hubs and stations, covering more than 8,500 ZIP codes and reaching over 70% of the U.S. population, GOFO provides consistent, high-performance last-mile delivery supported by automated sorting, intelligent routing, and disciplined operational execution. More information can be found at gofo.com.

About CIRRO E-Commerce CIRRO E-Commerce is an e-commerce logistics provider offering domestic and cross-border e-commerce logistics services. The company combines sortation capabilities, a robust transportation network, and local teams to support merchants, with an operational footprint in more than 30 countries.

Media Contact Tony Wang Public Relations, GOFO publicrelations@gofoexpress.com

SOURCE GOFO

Directeur de HUB - GOFO

# Directeur de HUB

- Île-de-France, Lyon 

## Responsabilités

 Management opérationnel : • Superviser et coordonner l’ensemble des activités du Hub (réception, tri, expédition, flux entrants/sortants). • Garantir l’atteinte des objectifs de performance : productivité, qualité de service, respect des délais. • Assurer la bonne application des process et standards de l’entreprise. Management d’équipe : • Encadrer et animer les équipes (chefs d’équipe, agents de tri, manutentionnaires, caristes, personnel administratif). • Superviser, avec l’appui des RH et des agences partenaires, l’utilisation des effectifs intérimaires (quantité, qualité, coûts). • Participer au suivi budgétaire lié à l’emploi des intérimaires et veiller à l’optimisation des ressources. • Recruter, former, développer et fidéliser les collaborateurs permanents. • Organiser et superviser plusieurs shifts (matin, après-midi, nuit) afin d’assurer la continuité des opérations. • Définir et suivre les plannings, en tenant compte des pics d’activité. Pilotage et performance : • Suivre les KPI opérationnels (taux de service, taux d’erreur, coûts opérationnels, sécurité) et mettre en place des plans d’action pour améliorer l’efficacité et réduire les coûts. • Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines, techniques et matérielles tout en assurant la maîtrise du budget global du Hub (ressources humaines, matériels, énergie et consommables). • Élaborer les prévisions budgétaires, suivre les écarts et proposer des mesures correctives pour garantir la performance et la rentabilité des opérations. Qualité, sécurité et conformité : • Garantir le respect des normes de qualité, sécurité et hygiène (HSE). • Veiller à l’application des procédures réglementaires (sûreté, règles sociales). • Assurer la conformité avec le Code du travail et les obligations légales en matière d’emploi, horaires et sécurité. • Piloter les audits internes et externes. Coordination et reporting : • Assurer la communication régulière avec la direction. • Produire et analyser les rapports d’activité du Hub. • Collaborer avec les services Transport, Dernier Kilomètre, RH, IT, Administration, ainsi qu’avec l’équipe Data Analyse. 

## Exigences de l'emploi

 Formation : • Bac+3 à Bac+5 en logistique, transport, supply chain, management industriel ou équivalent. Expériences : • 5 à 10 ans d’expérience en gestion d’entrepôt, hub logistique, plateforme de tri ou centre de distribution. • Expérience significative dans le management d’équipes nombreuses (>50 personnes). • Familiarité avec la gestion des budgets liés aux effectifs intérimaires. Compétences techniques : • Maîtrise des outils de gestion logistique et systèmes d’information (WMS, TMS). • Bonne compréhension des flux transport/messagerie. • Gestion des indicateurs de performance (KPI). Compétences comportementales : • Leadership et capacité à fédérer les équipes. • Sens de l’organisation et de la rigueur. • Capacité d’adaptation face aux imprévus et aux pics d’activité. • Orientation résultats et respect des objectifs opérationnels. 

## Ce que nous offrons

 • Nous offrons un environnement collaboratif pour travailler sur des missions passionnantes, ainsi que des opportunités continues de développement personnel et professionnel. • Un package salarial attractif ; • Travailler dans un environnement international et interculturel pour un grand groupe ; • Une entreprise en mode start-up avec une croissance rapide et de vastes perspectives ; • Différents avantages : mutuelle, carte Swile (titre-restaurant), remboursement 50% Pass Navigo, etc. 

J’apprécie vraiment de travailler dans un environnement qui m’a permis de développer mes compétences relationnelles. Aider nos chauffeurs, qui sont au cœur de l’entreprise, est un travail extrêmement valorisant.

Kiara Ayala

Équipe Relations Publiques

## Full job description

GOFO is a fast-growing logistics and last-mile delivery company focused on providing efficient, reliable, and technology-enabled transportation solutions. Our operations support a broad network of customers, carriers, and logistics partners, with a strong emphasis on service quality, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Website: https://www.gofo.com/ca

Position Summary

The Hub Head / Deputy Hub Head is responsible for overseeing overall hub and warehouse operations, including package sorting, distribution, staff management, operational performance, and process improvement. This role ensures that daily warehouse activities are carried out efficiently, safely, and in alignment with company standards.

The successful candidate should have strong warehouse management experience and the ability to coordinate overall hub operations, manage teams, monitor performance, and drive continuous improvement in a fast-paced logistics environment.

Responsibilities

- Oversee daily operations at the hub, ensuring efficient package sorting and distribution.
- Manage staff performance and provide training to enhance team productivity.
- Implement best practices for logistics management to improve operational efficiency.
- Coordinate with other departments to streamline processes and resolve issues promptly.
- Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess hub performance and identify areas for improvement.
- Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies during all operations.

Requirements

- Minimum 2 years of warehouse management experience.
- Proven experience in logistics or supply chain management, preferably in a leadership role.
- Experience overseeing overall warehouse or hub operations and coordinating day-to-day operational activities.
- Package sorting or parcel sorting experience is considered an asset.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Excellent communication skills for team collaboration and stakeholder engagement.
- Analytical mindset with experience in performance metrics evaluation.
- Ability to adapt to a fast-paced environment and drive operational improvements.
- Ability to lead teams, manage operational priorities, and coordinate overall warehouse performance.
